controls.definition: identical signal instants/eligibility, direction reversed (direction_sign * -1); funding cashflow re-evaluated with reversed sign
controls.required_outcome: MUST NOT satisfy all critical gates

controls.definition: two frozen variants: decision_time shifted by +8h and by -8h; each shifted decision uses only data <= its own shifted T
controls.required_outcome: NEITHER variant may satisfy all critical gates
controls.pass_consequence: the control plan's evaluation_rule states generally that ANY control satisfying all critical gates falsifies mechanism identification => ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL; the gates fail_semantics enumeration lists only DIRECTION/OI/NULL
controls.documentation_defect: gates fail_semantics omits TIMING_CONTROL from the explicit enumeration
controls.classification: NON_BLOCKING_DOCUMENTATION_DEFECT (operative consequence unambiguous via the general rule; no contradiction)

controls.definition: OI confirmation leg removed; trade every extreme-funding decision with identical entry/exit/cost/funding rules
controls.required_outcome: MUST NOT satisfy all critical gates
controls.pass_consequence: ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (funding-only family already refuted as standalone edge, FAILED_RESEARCH_MEMORY #8)

controls.definition: same signal instants, direction replaced by deterministic SHA256(seed:asset:decision_time_ms) parity, NULL_SEED = 20260915
controls.pass_consequence: ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (mechanical artefact, e.g. zero-cost carry harvesting)

control_regression_semantics.rule: if a control satisfies ALL critical gates => ARC01 = DISCOVERY_FAIL (mechanism not identified)
